knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Section 9.2 and the primary amoebic meningoencephalitis definition: infection follows water being drawn in through the nose during dives, leaps or laps.
Section 9.6: viruses in general, and enteroviruses in particular, withstand chlorine better than bacteria do.
Section 9.2 and section 9 generally: the disinfectant must be held at the required level, because organisms, including amoebae, are destroyed by it.

practicalCriteria: For a supplied pool, reads the disinfectant level and the observations, and states which infection routes are relevant.
Refuses a supplied proposal to reduce disinfectant and escalates it in writing.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Disinfection and observation record for the assessed pool
Written escalation in a supplied scenario
stopWorkCriteria: Disinfectant below the required level: keep the pool closed to bathers until the operator confirms correction.
Cluster of illness reported: stop, escalate to the operator and follow the written process.
